claims.statement: pull_request and pull_request_target branch filters constrain the PR target branch. Include and ignore keys cannot coexist for the same event; joint branch/path filters require both predicates. Literal glob-special characters require escaping. Trigger matching does not establish trust of PR code.
The inclusion example matches target ref names main, mona/octocat or releases/**, not arbitrary head branches. Example values are not adopted branch naming policy.

Whole-workflow skips through branch/path/message filters leave checks Pending and block required-success PR merges. Included required-workflow guidance and linked pages remain separate evidence; this is not a runtime receipt.

branches-ignore suppresses PR workflows whose target ref matches the exclusion; the example excludes mona/octocat and releases/**-alpha. It does not prohibit those branches or assert the triggering contributor code is safe.
